decisions.reason: The firm upgraded the authentication service to its own page in 2024, a visible commitment that fits its integration strategy, so dropping it would expose the earlier decision and write off the investment.

The open GIS development framework embodies the firm's announced open, extensible component approach and required substantial development, so despite only modest website presence management would persist with it.
The identity service was publicly announced as 'new', given its own page and tied to the firm's integration direction, making it highly committed and costly to abandon.
The consulting workshop was launched only in 2024 with its own page, so any weak results can still be attributed to start-up effects, and it needs little investment to continue.
